overall: The AG found no violation: the Board lawfully met and voted to delegate responses to three OML complaints to the town administrator and legal counsel, with the chair signing on its behalf.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board did not properly respond to three earlier OML complaints, failing to adequately discuss their merits and the substance of the replies.
allegations.key_passage: Under the Open Meeting Law, the Board is permitted to meet to delegate the responsibility for responding to complaints.
